name: Gamenfy Higgsfield Animation Technology Pilot
purpose: Prove whether one existing approved Gamenfy character can feel genuinely alive through real articulated sprite animation before generating any park, mission-prop, skill-object or new-character asset packs.
priority: P2 while Website Ventures is active
sourceRule: Use one existing approved Daily Score Joey character source from img/lab/daily-score/joey/l01.webp through l10.webp. Never overwrite or reinterpret the approved l01-l10 evolution files.
hardRules: This pilot is not part of the active Website Ventures required queue.
No new Gamenfy character is generated for this test.
No park/environment is generated for this test.
No 11-mission prop pack or skill-object pack is generated for this test.
Choose one clean existing full-body source before any AutoSprite job.
Run WALK first. If WALK fails the life/identity/foot-contact gate, stop and do not spend on IDLE, JUMP or INTERACT.
If a bounded AutoSprite pilot still feels like a moving cutout, has repeated identity morphing, or cannot align feet/limbs convincingly, stop batching and prototype rigged 2D architecture instead.
Approved source art remains untouched; outputs go to a separate animation-pilot folder.

sourceSelection.instruction: Choose the clearest neutral full-body level with visible feet, legs and arms, an isolated readable silhouette and the least pose obstruction. Do not choose based on which level is coolest; choose the source that gives the animation model the best chance to articulate the real character cleanly.
sourceSelection.gate: Source is recognizable at app size, limbs and feet are visible enough to animate, and using it does not require changing the approved character design.

jobs.title: Real Walk Cycle
jobs.instruction: Create a natural relaxed walk cycle from the supplied existing Gamenfy character. Preserve the exact character design, face, outfit, proportions, colors and silhouette language. The legs must genuinely alternate through planted-foot, passing and forward-stride poses; arms should swing gently in opposition. Keep torso/head stable, feet consistent in size, no camera movement, no zoom, no new props, no outfit redesign, no face drift. The result should read as a character truly walking rather than a flat image being translated across the screen.
jobs.gate: At actual app render size the feet do not skate or melt, legs/arms visibly articulate, face/outfit remain the same character, frame-to-frame proportions stay stable and the loop seam is not distracting.
jobs.stopRule: If this fails after a bounded retry, stop the AutoSprite expansion and evaluate rigged 2D before spending on the remaining pilot jobs.

jobs.title: Natural Idle Cycle
jobs.instruction: Create a subtle natural idle loop from the exact same Gamenfy character source. Preserve identity, face, outfit, proportions and colors. Use only tiny breathing, a gentle weight shift and minimal natural blink/head movement. No waving, dancing, bouncing, large gestures, camera motion, new props or costume changes. It should make the character feel quietly alive while the user reads the surrounding UI.
jobs.gate: Same identity as WALK, no jitter or morphing, movement is visible but not distracting, loop is seamless and the feet remain grounded.

jobs.title: Expressive Jump
jobs.instruction: Create one expressive but believable jump action with the exact same Gamenfy character. Show clear anticipation with bent knees, takeoff driven by the legs, a readable airborne pose, landing compression and a short settle back toward neutral. Preserve face, outfit, proportions and colors. Do not simply translate the whole image vertically; knees, hips, feet and arms must genuinely articulate through the action. No camera movement, no new props, no costume changes.
jobs.gate: The jump reads as physical character motion at app size, has clear anticipation/takeoff/air/landing, identity remains stable and the body is not merely a flat cutout moving up and down.

jobs.title: Character + Separate Prop Interaction Proof
jobs.instruction: Animate the exact same Gamenfy character performing a short reusable interaction with an imaginary anchor point slightly in front of the body around waist height: notice the target, shift weight, reach one hand toward it, make a clear brief touch/press contact pose, then return naturally to neutral. Preserve exact face, outfit, body proportions and colors. Do not bake a visible prop, button, text or new object into the sprite. No camera movement. The empty contact point must remain spatially consistent so the app can render a separate HTML/CSS/image prop at that location.
jobs.gate: The hand/contact point stays consistent enough that a separately rendered prop can be aligned with it, the body visibly reacts to the interaction, and the architecture proves character + prop/FX can remain separate Lego-like layers.
jobs.stopRule: If the contact point wanders too much or the body/identity morphs, do not generate a prop library; test a rigged 2D character architecture instead.

integrationPilotAfterAssets.destination: Lab only first; never replace the live Daily Score character until approved
integrationPilotAfterAssets.implementationGoal: A small JS state machine chooses one prebuilt animation while the character can move along a coded ground plane and interact with one separately positioned temporary prop.
integrationPilotAfterAssets.mobileGate: Runs smoothly at iPhone viewport size without blocking scrolling or increasing layout shift; reduced-motion users get a stable frame.
integrationPilotAfterAssets.commercialReuse: If this interaction architecture works, the underlying technology may later become a premium website mascot/interaction add-on without reusing Joey's personal character.

explicitlyDeferred: broad motion batch across all existing characters
